freeze_scope: subjects + requirements + graders + counterexamples + tool surfaces + file↔slot map frozen pre-READY; exact prompt bodies written at step 1 from these subjects and pinned by fingerprint pre-RUN with runner refusal on mismatch

plan_loop_grader.applicability: FUNCTIONAL verdict, IDENTICAL both variants. Each applicable item must cite a non-empty section containing its proof keywords (fixed per task: the subject's file/function names); verdict matches items.
counterexamples_fail: verdict READY with an uncited item (both variants)
counterexamples_pass: plan with fenced HTML examples (inert, not evidence)

predicates_conditional.2b_non_goals: REQUIRED for pl-broad (needed: migration scope; omission ⇒ FAIL); NOT required for pl-covered/pl-uncovered/pl-contested (absence ⇒ PASS)
predicates_conditional.4_named_files: REQUIRED for pl-broad (risky; omission ⇒ FAIL); NOT required for the small subjects (absence ⇒ PASS)

predicates_unconditional.8: facts-vs-assumptions separation (corpus subjects carry uncertain context, so exigible)

plan_loop_grader.prohibition_11: no ACTIVE raw HTML AS SEMANTIC EVIDENCE (inert HTML inside fenced code is allowed; only evidence-carrying interpreted HTML fails)
plan_loop_grader.read_trace_validity_candidate_only: every candidate run must show ALL FIVE systematic files read + conditional assertions per trigger (spec/FULL present-or-absent); a candidate run violating them is INVALID (not FAIL); any INVALID run ⇒ screening INCONCLUSIVE (undelivered treatment, not a regression); a baseline run showing candidate-only artifacts (pointer event, ready-gate read) ⇒ GLOBAL FAIL (contamination). Counterexamples: candidate pl-covered with spec.md read → run INVALID → INCONCLUSIVE; baseline with a pointer event → GLOBAL FAIL.
plan_loop_grader.source: ELEVEN canonical gate predicates DERIVED FROM spec.md, read from `workflow/ready-gate.md` (single source); conditions and the prohibition are honored, not flattened

selection_rule: slot i takes the pointer variant iff file i is in the defer branch, else the neutral variant (k = 0..4 determined by the measure, mapping fixed here). `review-lead.md` + `plan-archive.md` are measured separately with their own branches (no slots, no auto-follow); their defer branches (if taken) are validated by `tests/pointer-follow-smoke.sh`, not the screening.
